name: no-a11y-regression
description: trigger: remediating accessibility, editing markup, emptying or removing an alt, aria-label, label or lang that an element already had, deleting a flagged element. avoid: breaking a requirement the previous revision met; interrupting a correct fix. Misses: a name lost while an element moves to another file, and a new element or a supplied name that is weak, which warn and do not block. Not production-grade: caught 23 of 51 regressions and refused 17 of 58 correct changes in the 2026-11-15 hardening review; known gaps are framework attribute syntax (Angular, Vue, Thymeleaf, JSP, ERB, Pug, Lit), icon-only controls that lose an aria-label, and an alt removed in some forms. [Session-enforced via PreToolUse and Stop hooks; needs git and a Python 3.11+. PreToolUse judges the file a tool call would write; Stop re-reads what the turn actually left on disk, so a file written through a shell heredoc is judged too. With no working Python the hook exits 2; without git, fail-open clients allow silently. A gate that cannot reach a decision refuses rather than allowing one it never judged. Enforcement at every commit and in CI still needs chock installed in the repo.]
